ability.Analytic.description: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves after the target.
ability.BadDreams.description: Reduces the HP of sleeping opposing Pokémon.
ability.Defiant.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat when its stats are lowered.
ability.FlameBody.description: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
ability.FlashFire.description: Powers up the Pokémon's Fire-type moves if it is hit by one.
ability.Frisk.description: The Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.
ability.Gluttony.description: Makes the Pokémon use a held Berry earlier than usual.
ability.GuardDog.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
ability.Heatproof.description: Weakens the power of Fire-type moves.
ability.Hospitality.description: When this Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally’s HP.
ability.Infiltrator.description: Passes through the opposing Pokémon's barrier and strikes.
ability.LightningRod.description: Draws in all Electric-type moves to boost its Sp. Atk stat.
ability.MindsEye.description: The Pokémon ignores opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghosts with Normal and Fighting moves.
ability.MoldBreaker.description: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
ability.Multiscale.description: Reduces damage the Pokémon takes when its HP is full.
ability.PoisonPuppeteer.description: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
ability.Protosynthesis.description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
ability.QuarkDrive.description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
ability.Regenerator.description: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.
ability.Stalwart.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
ability.StickyHold.description: Protects the Pokémon from item theft.
ability.Sturdy.description: It cannot be knocked out with one hit.
ability.SupersweetSyrup.description: A sickly sweet scent spreads the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.
ability.Technician.description: Powers up the Pokémon's weaker moves.
ability.TeraShell.description: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
ability.TeraShift.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
ability.TeraformZero.description: Eliminates weather and terrain on changing to Stellar Form.
ability.ToxicChain.description: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.
ability.WaterAbsorb.description: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move.
attack.alluring_voice.description: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
attack.blood_moon.description: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.
attack.burning_bulwark.description: The user’s intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.
attack.dragon_cheer.description: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
attack.electro_shot.description: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
attack.fickle_beam.description: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.
attack.hard_press.description: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
attack.ivy_cudgel.description: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
attack.malignant_chain.description: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
attack.matcha_gotcha.description: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
attack.mighty_cleave.description: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
attack.psychic_noise.description: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
attack.supercell_slam.description: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
attack.syrup_bomb.description: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.
attack.tachyon_cutter.description: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.
attack.temper_flare.description: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
attack.tera_starstorm.description: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.
attack.thunderclap.description: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
attack.upper_hand.description: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

pixelmon.abilities.hospitality: %s drank down all the matcha that %s made!
pixelmon.abilities.lightningrodredirect: %s's Lightning Rod drew in the attack!

pixelmon.abilities.quarkdrive: The Electric Terrain activated %s's Quark Drive!
pixelmon.abilities.quarkdrivebooster: %s used its Booster Energy to activate its Quark Drive!
pixelmon.abilities.supersweetsyrup: A supersweet aroma is wafting from the syrup covering %s!
pixelmon.abilities.waterabsorb: Water Absorb drew in the attack and healed %s!
pixelmon.archaludon.description: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.
pixelmon.chandelure.description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
pixelmon.darkrai.description: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
pixelmon.dipplin.description: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
pixelmon.dragonite.description: Dragonite is capable of circling the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.
pixelmon.dragonite.form.creator: Creator
pixelmon.duraludon.description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
pixelmon.fezandipiti.description: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.
pixelmon.furfrou.description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
pixelmon.gougingfire.description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
pixelmon.hydrapple.description: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
pixelmon.ironboulder.description: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.
pixelmon.ironcrown.description: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.
pixelmon.munkidori.description: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
pixelmon.ogerpon.description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.
pixelmon.okidogi.description: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
pixelmon.pecharunt.description: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
pixelmon.poltchageist.description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
pixelmon.ragingbolt.description: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.
pixelmon.raichu.description: If the electrical sacs become excessively charged, Raichu plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this Pokémon's nest.
pixelmon.sinistcha.description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
pixelmon.starmie.description: Starmie's center section-the core-glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this Pokémon has been given the nickname "the gem of the sea."
pixelmon.terapagos.description: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.
pixelmon.ursaluna.description: It was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
pixelmon.ursaluna.form.bloodmoon.descrip: This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.
item.pixelmon.gimmighoul_coin.tooltip: 宝可梦不小心掉落的东西。索财灵珍爱有加地收集着它。
item.pixelmon.blazikenite.tooltip: 让火焰鸡携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.swampertite.tooltip: 让巨沼怪携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.victreebelite.tooltip: 让大食花携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.meganiumite.tooltip: 让大竺葵携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.froslassite.tooltip: 让雪妖女携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.emboarite.tooltip: 让炎武王携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.eelektrossite.tooltip: 让麻麻鳗鱼王携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.chesnaughtite.tooltip: 让布里卡隆携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.delphoxite.tooltip: 让妖火红狐携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.pyroarite.tooltip: 让火炎狮携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.malamarite.tooltip: 让乌贼王携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.hawluchaite.tooltip: 让摔角鹰人携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.drampanite.tooltip: 让老翁龙携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.falinksite.tooltip: 让列阵兵携带后，在战斗时就能进行超级进化的一种神奇超级石。
item.pixelmon.eye_of_lugia.tooltip: 一个眼睛形状的水晶，是溺水的宝可梦遗弃的。
pixelmon.arceus.description: 据说它从虚无之处的一颗蛋中诞生，然后创造了整个世界。
pixelmon.barbaracle.description: 进化的时候2只分裂成7只的神奇宝贝，用7只份的力量战斗。
pixelmon.blaziken.description: 从手腕喷出的火焰包裹住双拳，打出的拳击能够把对手烧得焦黑。
pixelmon.breloom.description: 短小的手臂在出拳的时候就会猛地一下伸长，技艺令专业拳击手都相形见绌。
pixelmon.chesnaught.description: 靠身体冲撞就有着能够颠倒50吨坦克的力量。自己成为盾牌来守护伙伴。
pixelmon.clefable.description: 据说，如果看到一对皮可西蹦蹦跳跳的样子，就能获得幸福的婚姻。
pixelmon.cyclizar.description: 它性格温和，人们会在日常生活中坐在它的背上来移动。一万年前的壁画里描绘着那样的情景。
pixelmon.delphox.description: 凝视着树枝尖端上的火焰能进入精神集中的状态，以看穿未来的变故。
pixelmon.dragalge.description: 对擅自侵入地盘的东西吐出能够让游轮的船体都腐蚀的毒液。
pixelmon.drampa.description: 如果和自己成为朋友的孩子被欺负，就会找到欺负他的那个孩子家，然后用火燃烧殆尽。
pixelmon.eelektross.description: 用吸盘一样的嘴吸附在对方的身体上，将牙刺入后释放强力电流。
pixelmon.emboar.description: 胡须上燃烧着的火焰是精神集中的体现，能够熟练使用很多的招式。
pixelmon.entei.description: 据说当炎帝吼叫的时候，世界上就会有某处的火山开始喷发。
pixelmon.excadrill.description: 藉助变成钢铁的爪子和头上的钻头，不管多厚的铁板都能穿透。
pixelmon.falinks.description: 列阵兵由1个头头和5个跟班组成。头头的命令不可违抗。
pixelmon.feraligatr.description: 虽然平时的动作迟缓，但扑咬猎物的时候速度却是异常迅速。
pixelmon.floette.description: 在花田中飞来飞去帮忙照料快要枯萎的花。引出花的秘密力量来战斗。
pixelmon.froslass.description: 据说它能吐出零下50度的冷气，将猎物冻成冰块，然后装饰在自己的秘密巢穴中。
pixelmon.gimmighoul.description: 索财灵大约1500年前在宝箱里出生。它隐藏在老旧结实的宝箱中，有很高的防御力。但相对地，因为宝箱非常沉重，它的动作迟缓，不擅长移动。
pixelmon.goomy.description: 最弱小的龙宝可梦。因为生活在阴暗潮湿的地方所以黏滑的身体不会变干。
pixelmon.greninja.description: 压缩水做出手里剑，放出的高速旋转的手里剑可以将金属一分为二。
pixelmon.grimmsnarl.description: 通过用头发裹住全身，让肌肉的力量向上提升。能发挥出足以压倒怪力的力量。
pixelmon.hatterene.description: 由于会朝四周释放足以引起头痛的精神力量，其他生物都躲得远远的。
pixelmon.hawlucha.description: 体格虽小却有着能与怪力，铁掌力士等体格庞大的宝可梦势均力敌的技术。
pixelmon.hoopa.description: 它将喜欢的东西收集起来，然后通过光环将它们传送到秘密的地方。
pixelmon.indeedee.description: 会用头上的角读取对方的心情。雄性就像管家一样，在主人的身边打理一切。
pixelmon.landorus.description: 吸收风和雷转变成能量，给予土地营养，让大地变得丰饶。
pixelmon.lugia.description: 被传为海神的宝可梦。流传着在暴风雨之夜就能看见其身影的故事。
pixelmon.malamar.description: 能使用神奇宝贝中最为强力的催眠术，通过它来操纵对手的意识。
pixelmon.marowak.description: 可以熟练自如地运用自出生的时候就握着的骨头棒，性情凶暴。
pixelmon.meganium.description: 大竺葵呼出的气息中蕴藏着能让枯萎的花草复苏的不可思议的力量。
pixelmon.pyroar.description: 群体之中拥有最大火焰的鬃毛的雄性将作为首领率领大家。
pixelmon.rhyperior.description: 用力收缩肌肉，然后在一瞬间伸展开，可以将手中的石头发射出去。
pixelmon.sceptile.description: 两腕长出的叶子连大树都能轻松砍倒，非常锋利，在密林的对战中无人能敌。
pixelmon.scolipede.description: 用头上的钳子插入猎物体内，让对方动弹不得，再用剧毒给予致命一戳。
pixelmon.scrafty.description: 把蜕下来的皮往上提以减少伤害，同时踢向对手。据说头上的冠越大，地位越高。
pixelmon.skarmory.description: 坚固的钢铁身躯看上去很重，其实又轻又薄，飞行的时速可达300千米。
pixelmon.slowking.description: 被大舌贝咬过之后得到了能和获诺贝尔奖的科学家相提并论的智慧。
pixelmon.suicune.description: 在全世界四处奔跑，让污浊的水变得清澈。随北风一同消失。
pixelmon.swampert.description: 有着能拖动巨轮游动的强大力量。粗壮的臂膀一击就能打倒对手。
pixelmon.thundurus.description: 一边在空中盘旋，一边到处劈下电光引发山林火灾，因而招人讨厌。
pixelmon.tornadus.description: 在四面八方飞来飞去，此时，风力变得异常强烈，不管什么东西都会被吹飞。
pixelmon.victreebel.description: 嘴里贮藏着散发花蜜般香气的液体，那实际上却是可以溶解一切物体的溶解液。
pixelmon.zygarde.description: 基格尔德是生态属性的监督者。当卡洛斯地区与阿罗拉地区的生态系统出现剧烈变化时，核心们就会展开行动。

attack.origin_of_thunder.description: A 185-power Electric Z-Move that creates Burst Terrain. Inherits Electric Terrain; boosts non-neutral Electric effectiveness for Electric allies by 25%, reduces non-neutral incoming effectiveness against Electric allies by 25%, and adds 1 to usable catch multipliers. Neutral hits, immunities and capture bans are unchanged. Lasts until replaced or this battle ends.
